scope: Executed real stems.js adapter with mocked network, decode and activation. Does not establish service inference, SCNet quality, browser UI, or audio routing.

checks.name: Matching callers share one promise, POST, decode/activation and all progress
Progress listener failure cannot fail shared preparation or other listeners
Late callers receive current worker progress and share the polling request
A different backend conflicts without replacing or canceling active work
Cancel during source decoding creates no server job and permits clean retry
Immediate cancellation starts neither source decoding nor upload
Cancel during POST deletes the returned job before any channel download
Failed shared POST notifies both callers, releases active work, and can retry
Cancellation during channel download skips arrayBuffer/decode and activation
Cancellation during channel decode cannot activate partial or finished buffers
A progress callback can cancel before upload without a subsequent POST
Activation cancellation reaches its AbortSignal, preserves shared rejection and does not cancel completed cache
Committed activation rejects late cancellation and keeps shared subscribers in the handover phase
